title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding transforms categorical variables into a form that could be provided to ML algorithms to do a better job in prediction. Each category is converted into a new binary column. For example, if you have a 'weather' column with 'sunny', 'cloudy', and 'rainy', each will become a separate column with 0s and 1s indicating the presence of that category.

title: Effect on Model Bias
text: Adding a new feature to a model can affect its bias and variance. Consider how adding a one-hot encoded feature might change the model's ability to fit the training data. Does it make the model more flexible or more constrained?
